name: JB's Smokehouse Barbeque
description: The most popular and beloved dining destination at Six Flags Over Texas — JBs Smokehouse Barbeque is a magnificent Texas BBQ restaurant serving authentic smoked brisket, ribs and sausage with classic Texas sides. The most satisfying and quintessentially Texan dining experience at any Arlington theme park.
